description: Ask questions about the routes, mileage, stops, wait times, fuel purchases, and vehicle inspections saved in your MoveDefense driver account. View stored photos and saved condition notes in evidence cards, inspect a route timeline, and open the exact source record in MoveDefense. Compare recorded activity and identify missing information without exporting every document. Estimate route fuel use with the vehicle MPG you provide; estimates are separate from logged fuel purchases. Access is read-only and limited to your own available cloud records. Images are display copies; original evidence stays unchanged. A note or previous stop does not establish where damage occurred. Spark payouts and tips, bank reconciliation, tax filing, automatic receipt bookkeeping, and phone-only maintenance records are not supported.

defaultPrompt: Summarize my recorded routes, miles, and waiting time from the last seven days.
Review my fuel purchases from the last seven days and flag missing costs, gallons, or receipts.
Summarize my recent inspections and identify unfinished checks or recorded defects.
